items.t: Official boundary: the City of Delta publishes no boundary for the Cliff Drive name.

faq.q: Is Cliff Drive an official City of Delta neighbourhood?
faq.a: No. "Cliff Drive" is a Paragon sub-area name; the City of Delta plans this ground as part of the Tsawwassen community under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), and publishes no boundary for the name.

faq.q: Which school is in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: Cliff Drive Elementary, 5025 12 Ave, Delta — an elementary (K–7) school in School District 37, confirmed in the BC Ministry of Education K-12 schools file and on the school's SD37 site.

faq.q: Is there still a Tsawwassen Area Plan for Cliff Drive?
faq.a: No. The current Official Community Plan is Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan with no Tsawwassen Area Plan schedule; the former area plan was Schedule D.1 under the superseded Bylaw No. 3950.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
